ModuleDescription: Eye and face tracking from the PICO 4 Pro and PICO 4 Enterprise with the Pico Face Tracking app, as a native OSCFT for VRC module (no .NET needed). Pairing by code finds the headset when the PC address changes and encrypts the tracking data. Only for OSCFT for VRC; for VRCFaceTracking use Pico4FaceTracking-VRCFT.zip.
UsageInstructions: In the Pico Face Tracking app on the headset, press "Pair by code" and type the 6-digit code shown under Pairing in the module's settings.
